prompt: Create a vertical full-body fashion portrait in a minimalist sunlit studio: on the left, a photorealistic young East Asian woman with long black hair poses gracefully against a plain warm gray wall, wearing a fitted ivory ribbed knit long-sleeve maxi dress with a scoop neckline and a high side slit, plus white pointed high heels. She forms a heart shape above her head with both hands, smiles softly while looking slightly to the side, stands on one leg, and bends the other leg back in a cute playful pose. On the right side of the same wall, draw a large black pencil manga-style sketch version of her, matching the pose and outfit but exaggerated with an anime face, one eye winking, open cheerful smile, long flowing hair, curvy silhouette, and sketched high heels. Surround the manga figure with exactly 5 hand-drawn hearts, 4 sparkle/star doodles, and 3 short exclamation marks above the head. Use a seamless blend of real photography and wall illustration, as if the drawing is sketched directly onto the wall beside the model. The scene has soft natural daylight, diagonal window-shadow stripes across the floor and lower right wall, a clean concrete floor, warm neutral tones, realistic skin texture, elegant editorial styling, and no visible text or watermark. Keep the composition balanced with the real model occupying the left half and the manga sketch occupying the right half, both full-body and similar scale. Optional customization: make the model's outfit ivory, set the background to warm light gray, and make the overall mood cute, elegant, playful.

promptZh: 创作一张极简主义阳光摄影棚内的垂直全身时尚人像：左侧是一位写实的东亚年轻女性，留着 黑色长发，优雅地站在一面纯净的暖灰色墙壁前，身穿一件修身的象牙白罗纹针织长袖长裙，配有圆领和高开叉设计，脚踩白色尖头高跟鞋。她双手在头顶比心，侧头轻柔微笑，单脚站立，另一只脚向后弯曲，姿态可爱俏皮。在同一面墙的右侧，绘制一个与她姿势和服装相匹配的黑色铅笔漫画风格草图，夸张处理动漫脸部，一只眼睛眨眼，露出开朗的笑容，长发飘逸，身形曲线优美，并画出高跟鞋。在漫画人物周围画上 5 个手绘爱心、4 个闪烁/星星涂鸦，并在头顶上方画 3 个短感叹号。采用真实摄影与墙面插画的无缝融合，仿佛画作直接绘制在模特身旁的墙上。场景具有柔和的自然日光，地板和右下墙面投射出对角线的窗影，地面为干净的水泥材质，整体色调为温暖的中性色，皮肤纹理真实，具有优雅的编辑风格，且无可见文字或水印。保持构图平衡，真实模特占据左半部分，漫画草图占据右半部分，两者均为全身像且比例相似。可选自定义：将模特服装设为 象牙白，将背景设为 暖浅灰色，并将整体氛围设为 可爱、优雅、俏皮。
